title: 18 Papers Accepted at EMNLP 2026
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: Eighteen papers involving researchers from the RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project (AIP) have been accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing), one of the leading international conferences in natural language processing. Nine papers were accepted to the Main Conference, seven papers to Findings of EMNLP 2026, and two papers to other tracks and co-located conferences. For more information, please visit EMNLP 2026 .
